name: People Alliance
description: People Alliance, also known as the People Nation, is a Chicago-based coalition of street gangs originally organized inside Illinois state prisons in 1978 by the El Rukns (Black P. Stones), Vice Lords, and Latin Kings as a counterweight to the rival Folk Nation alliance. It was formally named and given a constitution on the streets in 1981. The Latin Kings were the primary force behind recruiting Hispanic and white gangs into the alliance throughout the early 1980s, drawing in groups across Chicago neighborhoods and suburbs such as Cicero.
